name: ActSeal
description: Issue Ed25519-signed receipts for agent tool calls and let anyone verify them publicly without trusting the caller host.

skills.name: Issue Receipt
skills.description: Posts an action plus input/output hashes and returns a portable Ed25519-signed receipt id for later verify.

skills.name: Verify Receipt
skills.description: Publicly checks a receipt id and returns valid/invalid plus payload and issuer public key with no auth.

skills.name: MCP Stdio Tools
skills.description: Exposes issue_receipt and verify_receipt over stdio MCP for Cursor, Claude Desktop, and similar clients.
